title: a launcher that times out is a task run with no answer, and the step stands as it stood
line: a fetch task whose launcher outlives its timeout is one task_run row, ended timeout, outcome no_answer, nothing measured but the time, the task's text hash the text's own; no run is logged on the step and the page is still on the fetch list; the launcher was started with the task's text as the system prompt, the entry rendered as the prompt, the model, the effort, the answer schema, a spending limit, the browser and no built-in tool

steps.say: the memorial's task at a launcher that never returns: the harness's stand-in for a launcher that times out

expect.why: the launcher's command is the task: the kind's text, the entry rendered with the script's call in place of the one that ends it, and the limits; no MCP configuration but an empty one is read, so no connector's tools load; the script's call is awaited, so the browser tool returns its line
the launch is a row whatever came of it
no run is logged on the step: nothing came in, and nothing is logged on a model's word
